mapIdentity.scope: Mapped 1917 recorder/inlet site way 448005769. The exact curved platform and rectangular landward end register the estimated above-ground enclosure.

note: Coursed granite recorder house, flat roof with plain coping, simple entrance; a pediment and iron grating identify the earlier intake on the same mapped platform.
